text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
JERUSALEM POST
- Government panel approves Har Homa neighborhood in Jerusalem
- US raps decision
- American files suit against Iran for daughter's death in bomb
- Shas ministers queried in Bar-On probe
- Probe ordered into Hizmeh shooting
- Panel: Friedman who shot Arab in Hebron mentally unstable
HAARETZ
- Netanyahu to Arafat: size of first redeployment will grow if Har Homa passes peacefully
- Police report says Palestinian security operations in Jerusalem increased
- Israeli arrested for Wall Street fraud of millions
- Police to recommend closing file on Lieberman over Broadcast Authority reports
- Senior officer says Israeli action in Hizmeh was unnecessary
- Poll: 50% of Israelis indifferent to Bar-On affair
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Hussein: Jerusalem building could threaten peace
- 12-year-old pregnant by her teacher who arrested
- U.S. Jew placed bomb near Peres
MAARIV
- Arafat: the situation is dangerous; army reinforces troops
- Shas ministers questioned in Bar-On affair
GLOBES
- Running deficit in balance of payments grew in two years by factor of 2.1 reaching record $4.9 billion in 1996
- Slowdown in economy continues
- Legal measures against bank workers who striked against court order
